text:
Incident Bot: ⚠️ High-error-rate detected on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (5m avg error 18%). Paging on-call. incident_id=INC-2026-0421
Alex Morgan: on it — looking at traces now.
Alex Morgan: initial triage: increased 500s from a malformed cache key after a runtime rollout.
Marco Diaz: do we have rollback available for that variant?
Priya Singh: yes, can rollback to model-v3b quickly. preparing command.
Casey Wu: tagging customer-impacted: list may include customers with dedicated instances and hosted-tenants using eu-west-1. run quick query to enumerate.
Priya Singh: run:
```
SELECT tenant_id FROM request_logs WHERE path='/v1/generate' AND region='eu-west-1' AND status>=500 AND ts > (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes');
```
Priya Singh: got ~28 tenant_ids, 3 flagged as enterprise (acct: redwood-pay, acme-ux, studio-ml).
Alex Morgan: mitigation plan: 1) rollback model variant in eu-west-1 2) purge bad cache entries 3) watch error rate for 15m.
Casey Wu: started rollback to model-v3b -> command: `redwoodctl rollout revert --region eu-west-1 --model model-v4-canary`
Incident Bot: Deploy bot: rollback job 3456 started by Priya Singh.
Marco Diaz: I'll scrub logs for any malformed cache write operations and put findings here.
(10 minutes later)
Priya Singh: rollback completed, error rate down to 1.2% now. :thumbsup:
Alex Morgan: good. keeping oncall until stable. forwarding to post-incident channel in 30m for postmortem scheduling.
Elaine Brooks: tagging billing/finance — we need customer impact assessment and to estimate eligible SLA credits. Elaine Brooks: @Finance Bot can you create a case and track potential credits for affected tenants? include timeframe and request IDs.
Finance Bot: created ticket FIN-2026-0894, assigned to Finance Ops. summary: potential SLA credits from incident INC-2026-0421.
Alex Morgan: quick impact summary for FIN: outage window 2026-04-21T10:12Z — 2026-04-21T10:48Z (36m); affected endpoints: /v1/generate (eu-west-1); approx 28 tenants with elevated errors, 3 enterprise tenants.
Marco Diaz: attaching fast logs snippet:
```
[2026-04-21T10:14:05Z] ERROR tenant=redwood-pay request_id=abc123 status=500 reason="cache key encoding error"
[2026-04-21T10:15:00Z] ERROR tenant=acme-ux request_id=def456 status=502 reason="upstream reject"
```
Casey Wu: action items from incident ops: 
- OPS-456: add validation in cache key serializer (Priya)
- OPS-457: add canary gating for model rollout that checks cache-schema (Marco)
- OPS-458: add automated billing flagger to mark tenants for credit review (Elaine)
Priya Singh: ETA on OPS-456: 3 working days. will open PR today.
Marco Diaz: OPS-457 I'll pair with release infra; ETA 5 days.
Elaine Brooks: OPS-458 finance-side: I will prepare a billing worksheet with affected tenant usage and estimated credit amounts. need a CSV export of affected tenant token counts between 10:12-10:48Z.
Alex Morgan: here's export command for ops to hand to finance:
```
redwood-analytics export --region eu-west-1 --start 2026-04-21T10:12:00Z --end 2026-04-21T10:48:00Z --endpoint /v1/generate --fields tenant_id,total_tokens,errors > eu-west1-INC-2026-0421.csv
```
Priya Singh: ran and uploaded eu-west1-INC-2026-0421.csv to secure-reports (s3://redwood-postmortems/INC-2026-0421/). Elaine, you should have access.
Elaine Brooks: confirmed. I'll calculate credit per our SLA table (see internal link: https://redwood.internal/sla-policy).
Finance Bot: FIN-2026-0894 updated: requested invoice adjustments for tenants: redwood-pay, acme-ux, studio-ml. please attach CSV and estimated credit amounts.
(1 hour later)
Elaine Brooks: preliminary credit estimates: redwood-pay -> $1,200; acme-ux -> $650; studio-ml -> $420. totals in sheet. I'll convert to official credit memos pending verification.
Alex Morgan: schedule postmortem — propose 2026-04-22 16:00 UTC. agenda: timeline, root cause, mitigations, billing impact & action items.
Casey Wu: I can lead the timeline section. Priya will cover technical root cause. Elaine will cover billing/credits. Marco will cover release safeguards.
Priya Singh: noted. will bring PR link and test plan for OPS-456.
Elaine Brooks: I'll produce the finance memo and send to affected customers + cc billing ops.
Finance Bot: FIN-2026-0894 status: in-review by Finance Ops. reference memos pending: MEMO-3421.
Alex Morgan: final ask before close: Elaine, please add a line-item spreadsheet with exact token counts and credit calculation formula so finance retention can cross-check. assign to FIN-2026-0894.
Elaine Brooks: done — attached and assigned. :white_check_mark:
Marco Diaz: follow-up: I'll create a small smoke test harness to validate cache keys on rollout. OPS-459 created.
Casey Wu: closing out incident thread: marking incident resolved and creating follow-up epic in the ops board with the above action items.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 changed status -> resolved by Alex Morgan. resolution_note="Rollback model variant + cache-key validation plan"
Alex Morgan: thanks everyone. please add any missing items to the postmortem doc and attend the 04/22 16:00 UTC postmortem.
Elaine Brooks: finance will update FIN-2026-0894 with final credit memos by 2026-04-23.
Priya Singh: PR for OPS-456: https://git.redwood.com/pr/1234 (reviewers: Marco, Casey).
Casey Wu: ack. thanks all. :pray:
